propositions: FILE_IMPACT event currently overloads empty file_impact as both 'author forgot' and 'no file impact', requiring consumers to assume conservative reading; a third explicit 'none' state is needed
file_impact_scope reducer state must transition through three mutually exclusive states (undeclared, paths, none) with last-writer-wins replacement logic in process_file_impact
set-file-impact CLI command must migrate from _REGISTRY to _ARGV_REGISTRY to support both array form and new --none form with reason validation (minimum 10 non-whitespace characters)

get_file_impact_scope library function must return {kind, reason, paths} dict reflecting current tri-state; declare_no_file_impact MCP tool must apply same reason validation and write identical state as CLI
rebar show must surface both file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason keys; existing get-file-impact array output remains unchanged
